title: Basic
description: One solid primary Button marks the main action of a view.

title: Variants
description: Solid, soft, outline, ghost and link, from most to least emphasis.

title: Sizes
description: Five control heights, xs to xl. Extra small buttons keep a 24px hit area.

title: Loading and disabled
description: Loading keeps the button's width and its label for screen readers. Disabled never relies on opacity alone.
